description: Land Acquisition - Karaduwawela, Yahalathenna, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (with lot numbers, descriptions, extents, and boundaries) for public purposes (construction of a pump house/water tank and mixed development). The content focuses solely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it a clear Land Gazette.
